jobs.prompt: Create a production game sprite sheet of the referenced character, preserving their comic character identity, clothing, face, colors and improvised weapon. EXACT regular grid: EIGHT columns and SIX rows, 48 evenly spaced full-body drawings, read left to right. Every cell same size, no lines labels text numbers. Face RIGHT in three quarter side combat view, same scale and fixed feet baseline. Each row a coherent temporal sequence with incremental poses, never unrelated drawings. Row1: 8 frames seamless breathing combat guard loop, independently moving arms weapon hair clothing, planted feet. Row2: 8 frames stationary weapon attack windup slash contact recovery to guard. Row3: 8 frames distinctive stronger weapon skill action windup powerful strike recovery. Row4: 8 frames defensive block raise weapon/shield absorb impact and settle. Row5: first FOUR frames recoil hurt and recover, last FOUR collapse incapacitated. Row6: 8 frames running right with coordinated limbs and intact feet. Keep character entirely inside every cell and identical size throughout. No scenery, particles or UI. Full sheet landscape 8:6 ratio. Anatomically coherent hands holding weapon, no extra limbs. Reference is character design only; remove all reference background. Hero warrior.
